text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Lübeck stood at 12.3 €/m², up 5.1 % year‑on‑year and 32.1 % over the last five years, placing the city 16th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 25th‑percentile level is 10.56 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 14.1 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 738 € per month.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 1.5 % and an average of 24 days on market; 26 % of listings are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 17.3 %, and asking rents sit 65 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 7.47 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 12.89 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 12.6 €/m² and 13.2 €/m², implying a further 4.8 % rise.
